design.paired_definition: test row whose (ligand_canonical, cell_line_key) is measured under a training metal
design.sampling: rows; n_paired drawn from the paired pool, the rest from the unpaired pool, without replacement
design.doi_group_arm: n_paired=0 with UP-8's whole-DOI sampler, as a reproduction check
design.ridge: dual form of the primal ridge used by msrs_meta_kshot.adapt_ridge

gain_decomposition.note: level gain is what a pure offset correction buys with no paired point; interaction gain is what the first three paired points add on top.

primary.metric: ridge, k=50, n_paired=3: metals with R2 > 0

secondary.metric: mean R2 over metals monotone non-decreasing, n_paired 0..3

kill.rule: fewer than 2 of 5 metals above zero at n_paired=3

caveats: Re has zero paired rows (UP-19 measured the same fact), so its n_paired > 0 cells silently fall back to n_paired = 0. The requested count is recorded next to the available count in every cell.
Calibration rows are sampled at row level, not by DOI group. The offset_doi_group arm isolates that change at n_paired = 0.
The ridge is solved in the dual (k x k); dual_vs_primal records the maximum absolute difference against the primal solve on the first cell.
R2 is computed on the evaluation rows of one metal, so it is a within-metal number and carries no metal-level information.
Twenty repeats per cell give a noisy mean; the seed spread is in per_seed.
